terra.problem: The blessing is for the Israelites, not Aaron and his sons. They are to receive and speak its words.
The claim that Joshua and Caleb appear in other Bible stories needs a reference outside this passage.
The claim that doorposts appear elsewhere in the Bible needs an outside reference.
The claim that stone tablets appear elsewhere in the Bible needs an outside reference.
The claim that nobody frowns while being blessed invents a universal reaction that the text does not give.
The line ends with “to you,” not the word “gracious.”
God says He will bless the Israelites. The passage does not say that God is the blessing.
